title: Soilwork: a reading companion to fundamental laws of soil, environmental and agricultural science
description:
Soilwork is an interactive single-page reading companion that explains fundamental laws and processes in physics, chemistry, soil science, environmental science, research methods and agricultural economics.

It contains 103 entries (30 full articles), a concept map, 14 reading paths, one-card briefs and a 216-question quiz built around common misconceptions. Wrong answers explain the misconception and link to the section to reread; 105 questions cite a textbook page. It runs as a static web page with no build step.
